title: Friedgut degree at one eighth
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its Friedgut degree at parameter $1/8$ equals the least integer greater than or equal to eight times its total influence: $\lceil 8 I(f)\rceil$, where $I(f)$ denotes its total influence.
